source: Transcribed from the Keysight E36300 Series Programmable DC Power Supplies Programming Guide (9018-04577). Cross-checked against pymeasure keysightE36312A/keysightE3631A and python-ivi agilentE3600A.

supplements.description: Enables or disables the specified output. The names CH1, CH2 and CH3 are other names for P6V, P25V and N25V. At *RST all outputs are off.
